notes:
CRM notes (shorthand, from AE/SE/Security threads):
- Company: Aegis Crypta Systems (insights & risk platform for small banks). Heavy compliance; cannot send unredacted PII off-prem without controls.
- Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with enterprise-grade key management. Must support AWS KMS + CloudHSM-backed keys; also evaluating Azure Key Vault and GCP KMS for multi-cloud DR. BYOK required (customer will import root keys or provide HSM attestation).
- KMS specifics discussed:
  * Prefer HSM-backed CMKs (CloudHSM / Azure Dedicated HSM) for signing and key custody. Need FIPS 140-2/3 attestation statement.
  * Envelope encryption model: Redwood holds ephemeral data keys, master keys in customer KMS. Support for CMEK/CSE (customer-managed encryption keys).
  * Key import scenarios: Bring-your-own-key (pkcs12 / key import job), support for key rotation policy and automated rewrap.
  * Multi-cloud considerations: key replication vs separate keys per region; Aegis wants residency per region (EU/NA split) — critical for regulatory reports.
  * Audit logging: must forward KMS usage logs to customer SIEM (CloudTrail + Azure Monitor + GCP Audit Logs) and Redwood audit logs. Need log retention 7 years for some use cases.
  * Access model: RBAC + SAML SSO for operators; split of duties between infra and security; hardware-backed signing for crypto operations.
- POC scope: Private VPC, 2 GPUs reserved, integrate AWS KMS with BYOK imported key, end-to-end encryption at rest and transit, validate audit log forwarding, run latency tests (target 40–80ms p50 for chat flows), cost analysis.
- Security feedback so far: OK on SOC2/ISO artifacts; ask from SecOps: provide key lifecycle diagram, key deletion/rotations SOP, proof of key attestation. Legal: need contract language for key custody and breach notifications.
- Customer quotes: "We cannot accept vendor-controlled master keys; must be able to audit key usage and rotate keys on our schedule."
- Risks: Multi-cloud KMS design increases complexity; time to get HSM procurement and attestation from customer side (internal CA) could delay POC. Procurement timeline uncertain.
- Docs to share: Redwood private VPC architecture diagram, KMS integration guide (AWS/Azure/GCP), BYOK import checklist, HSM attestation template.
- Internal notes: SE to prepare architecture with both CloudHSM-backed CMK and KMS-imported key flows; include fallback route to Redwood-managed keys for demo if customer cannot import keys in time (must be gated by explicit waiver).
- Close signals: customer has internal budget for dedicated infra and prefers annual reserved contract if performance & security validated.
- Next: send updated diagram + KMS runbook by 2026-03-17, schedule CISO deep dive for week of 2026-03-22.
